column2: ENGLISH
Has not hired out the Kossars in the last fifteen years
The Kossars ride home at once. The southern prince keeps the rest of the contract money.
The Kossars come home hard and proud, and teach the levies what they learned in the south.
The Kossars come home with southern gold in their saddlebags, and your share of it.
Fewer come home than went. The ones who return tell the story of the ones who did not.
You cut it down, but by morning the body is gone. Trolls heal.

The bear-master leads it out into the courtyard on a chain as thick as a man's wrist: a great bear of the line of Urskin, the bear that Tzar Boris rode against the hordes. It is taller than a horse at the shoulder. It looks at you for a long moment, then lowers its head.
Urskin rides again.

A caravan has come down the High Pass out of the east: two hundred camels and yaks, loaded with jade, silk, spices and ivory from far Cathay. It has crossed the Ogre lands to reach Praag, and the merchants are asking for an escort west. They are also, the tax-farmers point out, very rich.
Give them an escort, for a fee.
Tax them for every bale.
Let them pass freely. Word will spread.
A rider comes in from the Pass, half dead. The caravan was attacked in the high valleys by raiders, some say Ogres and some say greenskins, and the escort is fighting for its life.
Ride to their rescue.
They are already lost.
The merchants of Cathay have long memories. Word of Praag's tolls has gone back along the road, and for years to come the caravans will go round by the south and the Pass will be empty.
Their loss.

The captain of the Kreml Guard kneels before the Ice Throne in full armour, with the whole guard behind him. He swears the old oath in person: to stand between the crown and every knife in the dark, until death or the end of the reign.
I accept your oath.
Swear it again, on Ursun's altar.

The Kossars have come home. Ten years ago they rode south to fight for a foreign prince. Now they ride back through the gates in a long column, burned brown by southern suns, and the whole town turns out to count them.
Welcome home.

A letter has come from the captain of the Kossars you hired out to the south. They have taken a city in Tilea for their prince and held a pass in the Border Princes against greenskins. The prince is slow to pay, the wine is thin, and every man of them misses the snow.
Good. They make Kislev proud.
Longships have been seen off the coast of [north_raided_coast.GetName], a dozen of them with dragon prows and painted shields. By tomorrow the Norscans will be on the beaches.
Meet them on the shore.
Pay them to sail on.
Send Erengrad's ships to catch them at sea.

The raiders are broken and their jarl has been dragged before you in chains, still laughing. He says his people will pay for him, or burn your coast for a hundred years if you kill him. He seems curious which you will choose.
Ransom him to his people.
Bring him before Ursun.
Keep him. His people will keep the peace while he lives.

The thaw has come to the north, and with it the trolls. One has come down from the hills into [north_troll_province.GetName], and the herdsmen say it has eaten forty cattle and two men, and is still hungry.
Hunt it down.
Pay the troll-hunters.
Bar the gates and wait for it to move on.
The troll is back. The one you cut down a year ago has grown back the arm you took and is eating the herds again, and it seems to remember you.
Burn it this time.
Call on the Circle of the Bear.
Urskin's Bear in the Forest
A great bear of Urskin's line roams the forests here. The people say it guards them.
The High Pass Trade
Word has spread that Praag treats the caravans well, and more of them come.
Cathay Shuns the Pass
The merchants of Cathay take the long road round, and the High Pass is empty.
Raided by Norscans
Norscan longships have burned this coast.
A Troll Loose
A troll is eating its way through the herds of this province.
Sworn by the Kreml Guard
The Kreml Guard has sworn to stand between this ruler and every knife in the dark.
Kossars Abroad
A company of Kossars is fighting for a southern prince.
Hired Out the Kossars
Has hired out the Kossars recently.
Kossar Veterans
The Kossars have come home from the south and are teaching the levies.
Norscan Hostage
Holds a Norscan jarl as hostage, and his people leave this coast alone.
Raise a Bear of Urskin's Line
Have the Tzar's bear-master raise a great bear of the line of Urskin, the bear that Tzar Boris rode. One for each Tzar. It dies with its rider, or goes back to the wilds, and never passes to an heir.
Hire Out the Kossars
Hire a company of Kossars out to a southern prince for ten years. Gold now, fewer men at home until they come back.
Recall the Kossars
Chaos has come. Buy out the Kossars' contract and bring them home.
Bear of Urskin's Line
A great bear of the line of Urskin, taller than a horse at the shoulder. It serves one rider, and when he dies it will serve no other.
Troll-Hide Cloak
A cloak of grey-green troll hide that knits itself back together when it is cut.
Builds Tall
Holds the whole of Kislev and guards it.
